[SWS_DM_00951] Configuration of DTC "current FDC" as extended data record
⌈
If the configuration parameter DiagnosticProvidedDataMapping.dat-
aProvider of the corresponding DiagnosticParameter.dataElement is set to
DEM_CURRENT_FDC, the DM shall report the internal value of the current Fault De-
tection Counter of the contextual DTC in the respective DiagnosticExtended-
DataRecord’s DiagnosticDataElement.
The length of this internal data element is one byte.
⌋
